prs.title: fix(shared): make McpError and UrlElicitationRequiredError pickle-safe on v1.x
prs.author: NishchayMahor
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: pickle-safety for MCPError and UrlElicitationRequiredError: Python's default Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs via cls(*self.args), but MCPError.__init__ stores only the message string in self.args (via super().__init__(error.message)), so unpickling calls MCPError(message_str) and crashes because __init__ expects ErrorData. members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2703: pickle-safety for MCPError and UrlElicitationRequiredError: Python's default Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs via cls(*self.args), but MCPError.__init__ stores only the message string in self.args (via super().__init__(error.message)), so unpickling calls MCPError(message_str) and crashes because __init__ expects ErrorData. UrlElicitationRequiredError has a further mismatch because its constructor signature (elicitations, message=None) doesn't match the args tuple at all. All three PRs fix issue #2431.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #2514 implements the affirmative correct behavior required by the spec (sending CancelledNotification) and subsumes the negative fix from #2493 (not sending an error response). #2493 only removes incorrect behavior without adding the required notification; #2514 also removes the pragma: no cover annotation from the same guard clause both PRs touch, suggesting it was written with knowledge of #2493's concern.

members.title: fix: don't send a response for cancelled requests
members.author: Zelys-DFKH
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2514: RequestResponder.cancel() violates the MCP cancellation spec: it currently sends an error response instead of (a) sending no response and (b) emitting a CancelledNotification. PR #2493 removes the incorrect error-response send and fixes the server to not send any response for cancelled requests. PR #2514 adds the required CancelledNotification send (imports CancelledNotificationParams). Both diffs edit the same lines inside cancel() and are two sides of the same protocol compliance fix.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #2565 retains the original exception message inline (`f"...{e}"`), which keeps the error description self-contained in logs that don't display the full traceback chain. Both fix the same sites; #2565's approach is the more conservative change and was opened first.
